Budget.description: Spending from paid, unrefunded orders (outlet business dates, campus time zone).
Budget.title: Budget

CheckoutRequest.description:
Start an online payment. For an order the server reads the amount; for a top-up the
student picks it (₹50 to ₹5,000).
CheckoutRequest.title: CheckoutRequest

Deal.description:
Prepared food from an uncollected order, offered at a discount (REQUIREMENTS.md D-19).
Prices are set by the server when the deal is listed.

MenuItemInput.description: Replaces every editable field. Prices are integer paise.

OrderCreate.description: Prices and totals are never accepted from the client; the server computes them.

OutletSummary.description: Today's figures for one outlet, computed from real orders (outlet-local business date).

OwedRefund.description:

paid into the student's wallet within the last 30 days.
OwedRefund.title: OwedRefund

ProfileUpdate.description: Fields a user may change about themselves. Anything else is rejected (422).
ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate

QueueStats.description: Derived from real order load (REQUIREMENTS.md D-2, D-17); not from sensors.
QueueStats.title: QueueStats

Review.description: Public and anonymous: never who wrote it.
Review.title: Review

StaffOrder.description: An order as the counter sees it: never the pickup code, but the customer's name.
StaffOrder.title: StaffOrder

TodaySpecial.description: Today's special for an item: the server-computed price and portions left (D-16).
TodaySpecial.title: TodaySpecial
